component.name: Fleck
component.summary: Sticky notes for the COSMIC desktop

description.p: Fleck keeps sticky notes on your desktop. Each note is its own window on lined paper, saved as you type, and a notes list lets you search, open, rename and delete them. A panel icon brings the list up from anywhere.
Fleck follows your COSMIC theme, accent colour and light or dark mode.

ul.li: A note per window, saved as you type
A notes list with search, most recently edited first
Nine note colours, or the theme's own look
Images pasted or dragged into a note
Reopens the notes you had open when you last quit
Undo and redo in every note
Notes are plain Markdown files you can read anywhere
